observations: Photo 0 shows a light/cream 2-seater couch with padded arms and back.
Upholstery appears intact with no obvious large tears or stains visible in the photo.
Foam firmness cannot be confirmed from the image.
No visible brand/model label in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show usage duration; only general condition is visible.
Photo 0 has no measuring reference to confirm length.
No receipt/label or date proof visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: No stain, no tear, foam still firm
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows no obvious tear/stain, but firmness and hidden wear (sagging, internal foam) cannot be confirmed remotely.
No way to verify smoke exposure from photo 0.

risks.risk: Hidden sagging/soft foam or broken internal frame (photo cannot confirm firmness).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the seller pressing down firmly on the seat and backrest from multiple spots, plus a side view showing how it rebounds.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used 2-seater sofa with unknown firmness (worst case: not as firm as claimed).

risks.risk: Small stains/odor (especially on light fabric) not visible in the single photo.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the seat seams, corners, and underside edges in bright light, and a quick smell/airing confirmation video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if stains/odor could exist (worst case: needs cleaning).

risks.risk: Length/size mismatch ("over 4 feet" may be inaccurate).
risks.proof: Ask for a tape-measure photo showing total length from one end to the other.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard 2-seater couch without relying on the stated length.

risks.risk: Color/finish wear (light couch may show fading or wear patterns not captured).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo taken from directly above and from the side under consistent lighting to show any fading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average condition used upholstery.

proof_requests: Video: press test on seat/back (show rebound) from at least 3 different points.
Close-ups: seat seams, corners, and underside edges (bright light).
Tape-measure photo: total length and seat width.
Any receipt/brand tag photo (if available) to confirm make and age.
response.reason: The photo clearly shows a 2-seater couch in generally good visible condition, but key claims (firmness, exact size, true age) are not provable remotely, so it should be priced at the worst-case used condition.
